rachel: Heads-up: after the int4 canary for seabird-lite we see ~0.3% tool-invoke schema rejects. Dash: https://dash.internal/runs/4999
omar: samples? i grabbed a failed payload and it ended with an incomplete escape: `...\\"meta\\": {\\"id\\": 123}\\"` (extra backslash + quote) -> json parse error
kevin: interesting. our streaming encoder inserts debug escape markers (`\\E`) when a kernel fallback is hit. if a chunk cut happens inside the escape sequence we get a stray backslash at the end of a chunk.
rachel: repro: stream=true + kv-cache on + long context (~1k tokens). qa-bot posted a minimal reproducer:
qa-bot: ```bash
curl -X POST https://canary.internal/invoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY' -d '{"model":"seabird-lite-q4","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"long..."}],"tools":[{"id":"index","schema":{}}]}'
```
kevin: mitigation ideas: (1) runtime sanitizer that collapses dangling backslashes before parse (2) kernel change to not emit debug escapes in prod streaming (3) update retry policy to not retry 4xx schema errors.
omar: quick client patch i tested: replace `\\\\$\\"` patterns and also join split chunks before parse. simple python: `payload = payload.replace('\\\\', '')` (yeah hacky).
rachel: action items: kevin -> kernel change WIP, omar -> add unit test for chunk-split-backslash, infra -> runtime sanitizer behind ff and canary roll (deploy-bot), product -> notify small set of dedicated canary customers if we see SLA hits.
kevin: opened kernel PR: https://git.internal/infra/kernels/pull/231 (WIP)
omar: tests PR: https://git.internal/eng-ml/stream-tests/pull/95
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: runtime-sanitize-quick -> seabird canary at 4999991160 10% -> 100% in 20m if green
rachel: thanks team. keeping thread for updates.
